earnings.reaction: hawkish hold - BTC popped then faded
earnings.note: RESOLVED. Rates held at 3.50-3.75% for a fifth meeting on a 9-3 vote; Hammack, Kashkari and Logan dissented in favour of an immediate hike to 3.75-4.00% - a sharp break from June when all 12 voted to hold. Warsh rejected the idea that July was a routine pause, called it an active assessment of options rather than the start of easing, said June's softer inflation print influenced the committee 'not much', and conceded higher rates could still be needed. Asked about the dissents he said he asked for a good family fight and got one. He also pointed to already-tighter financial conditions and flagged the August Jackson Hole symposium as where he may guide on the September 15-16 meeting. BTC's path: above $64,400 on the headline, $64,752 high, then a steady all-evening fade to $63,727.

calibration.rollingRecord: Five sessions, zero blow-ups, and the discipline keeps paying. Midday's reduce rail ($63,000 on a 4H close) did NOT fire - spot closed the session at $63,727 - and the $62,200 invalidation has now held through the single biggest event of the month. Midday's explicit call was to NOT force an add into a coin-flip print; that was correct twice over, because the pop it would have chased ($64,752) was fully retraced within four hours. The morning's small DCA tranche is the only cost: the spot core of 0.00336315 BTC at an average $64,086 marks at roughly -$1.2 unrealised against $63,727. Cash was $13.40 into this session and is now put to work as a hedge rather than left idle.
calibration.note: Midday bias (range, bull 26 / range 48 / bear 26, tilt BULLISH, reduce $63,000 / add $65,631, confidence 5.0) was HALF right and half wrong, and it is worth being precise about which half. Right: range held, no reduce fired, the coil-into-the-event read was accurate, and refusing the pre-FOMC add avoided buying the exact high. Wrong: the BULLISH tilt. Midday leaned bullish on the equities-divergence argument - BTC defending $64,000 while QQQ and VOO sold off - and that divergence resolved the OTHER way, with BTC capitulating to the equity tape after the print instead of leading it. Lesson logged: a crypto-holds-while-stocks-fall divergence measured hours BEFORE a binary macro event is not evidence of strength, it is evidence of an unhedged crowd waiting. Endday therefore flips the tilt to BEARISH (bull 22 / range 44 / bear 34), moves the add rail down from $65,631 to the far more actionable $64,350 reclaim, keeps the $63,000 reduce rail, and raises confidence only because the event is resolved.
